$comment: PIP-Hall design tokens. Single source of truth; export with tokens_export.py, never hand-edit the exported theme.
ref1 = pixel-art handheld scene (user reference, 2026-10-04). ref2 = lanyard ID badge illustration (user reference, 2026-10-04). Colors sampled from the images with a median-cut palette.
The member card keeps its own palette (color.card.*) in both modes: it is a physical object lit the same in DAY and NIGHT.
color.world.* (added 2026-10-04, design v2): the platformer level inside the screen. Original colours; no colour is sampled from any Nintendo asset.

display.$description: ref: chunky pixel lettering of ref1's dialogue box and ref2's bold name. Jersey 10 (OFL) replaced Pixelify Sans on 2026-10-04 after a render check: Pixelify merges C/O and B/8 at 11-16px (B and 8 became indistinguishable). Condensed, so display sizes are 1.25x the body scale. Single weight: font-synthesis none. Self-hosted via @fontsource/jersey-10

1.$description: ref: ref1 pixel step; every edge lands on the 4px pixel grid

control.$description: user: spec DESIGN_SYSTEM.md section 4 (square and stepped corners); stepped corners are drawn with clip-path, not border-radius

hard.$description: user: spec DESIGN_SYSTEM.md section 4 hard shadows; ref: ref1 ink

card.$description: user: spec hard shadow, deeper for the hero card

flip.$description: user: spec section 10 upper range for the card flip

easing.$description: aegis-default: quick start, soft landing for flip and snap; lanyard swing uses a spring instead

sprite-fps.$description: delegated: sprite frame clock, stepped (8-12fps), design v2

swing-spring.$description: delegated: badge pendulum stiffness; damping 0.86 per frame; cap 12deg

md.$description: aegis-default: tablet, side cards start peeking at full size

lg.$description: aegis-default: desktop, bezel at full width
